preconditions.expression: all(len(s) >= 2 and len(s) <= 50 for s in test_cases)

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in {'E', 'N'} for c in s) for s in test_cases)

postconditions.description: For each test case, 'YES' is printed if and only if there exists an array a consistent with the equality/non-equality constraints in s.
